sources.title: AI sharpens hurricane forecasts, but humans still call the shots
SW Iowa plane crash victims identified

en.title: AI sharpens hurricane forecasts Tech Xplore reported
en.dek: Tech Xplore reported on 11 November 2026 that AI sharpens hurricane forecasts, but human personnel maintain decision authority.
facts: Tech Xplore reported on 11 November 2026 that AI sharpens hurricane forecasts.
Tech Xplore stated that human personnel maintain decision authority regarding hurricane forecasts.
body: Tech Xplore reported on 11 November 2026 that AI sharpens hurricane forecasts.
The outlet stated that human personnel maintain decision authority regarding these forecasts.
en.context: MSC News reported the identification of plane crash victims in SW Iowa on 11 November 2026, a separate event from the hurricane forecasting report.

ja.title: AIがハリケーン予報を精緻化
ja.dek: Tech Xploreは11月11日、AIがハリケーン予報を精緻化する一方で、人間の職員が意思決定の権限を保持していると報じた。
facts: Tech Xploreは11月11日、AIがハリケーン予報を精緻化することを報じた。
Tech Xploreは、ハリケーン予報に関する意思決定の権限を人間の職員が保持していると述べた。
body: Tech Xploreは2026年11月11日、AIがハリケーン予報を精緻化していると報じた。

同メディアは、これらの予報について人間のスタッフが決定権を保持していると述べた。  Check: "human personnel" -> 人間のスタッフ is okay. "maintain decision authority" -> 決定権を保持している. "regarding these forecasts" -> これらの予報について. Good.  Maybe "Tech Xplore" should be in katakana? The instruction says keep names accurate; use established local spelling. Tech Xplore is an English name; Japanese media often keep it as Tech Xplore. I'll keep Tech Xplore.  Need neutral register of quality newspaper. "報じた" and "述べた"

ko.title: AI가 허리케인 예보를 정밀화한다
ko.dek: Tech Xplore가 2026년 11월 11일 AI가 허리케인 예보를 정밀화했다고 보도했으나, 최종 결정권은 인력이 유지한다
facts: Tech Xplore가 2026년 11월 11일 AI가 허리케인 예보를 정밀화했다고 보도함
Tech Xplore가 인력이 허리케인 예보 결정 권한을 유지한다고 밝힘
body: Tech Xplore는 2026년 11월 11일 AI가 허리케인 예보를 정밀화한다고 보도했다.
해당 매체는 인간 인력이 이러한 예보에 대한 최종 결정 권한을 유지한다고 밝혔다.

de.title: KI verfeinert Hurrikansprognosen, berichtet Tech Xplore
de.dek: Tech Xplore berichtete am 11. November 2026, dass KI die Hurrikansprognosen verfeinert, wobei menschliches Personal die Entscheidungsbefugnis behält.
facts: Tech Xplore berichtete am 11. November 2026, dass KI die Hurrikansprognosen verfeinert.
Tech Xplore gab an, dass menschliches Personal die Entscheidungsbefugnis bezüglich Hurrikansprognosen behält.
body: Tech Xplore berichtete am 11. November 2026, dass KI die Hurrikansprognosen verfeinert.
Die Redaktion führte aus, dass menschliches Personal die Entscheidungsgewalt bezüglich dieser Prognosen behält.
de.context: MSC News berichtete am 11. November 2026 über die Identifizierung von Opfern eines Flugzeugabsturzes in Südwest-Iowa, ein separates Ereignis vom Bericht zur Hurrikansprognose.

problemsFixed: The draft mixes two unrelated events (hurricane forecasting and a plane crash) without clear separation, violating the principle of focused reporting.
The headline is not a factual statement of what happened, but a summary of a claim.
The draft uses filler and evaluative framing (e.g., 'This report from MSC News did not mention...').
The structure does not adhere to PLAIN style guide requirements (e.g., opening paragraphs with actor/number/date, varying sentence length).
